title: Relationship Manager - ABG
description:
**Key Result Areas**
 Supporting Actions
   

  

 Sales Growth \& Client Acquisition
   

  

* Build and maintain a pipeline of new business opportunities with large enterprises/MSMEs relating to Supply Chain Finance
* Deliver on sales targets and KPIs by building strong relationships with customers and channel partners, and provide regular updates on sales performance and pipeline health
* Maintain organizational goals on portfolio ROE and quality
* Segment the market and identify potential direct clients, approach them and generate business through customized digital lending offerings that meet client requirements
* Establish strong relationships with key stakeholders and decisionmakers within strategic accounts


 Distribution \& Market Expansion
   

  

* Upsell and Cross\-sell in Key Accounts
* Develop and strengthen distribution network through liaising and networking efforts considering product positioning and competition
* Scan the market and its competitive offerings on a periodic basis; report on emerging trends and business opportunities for the unsecured segment
* Engage with regional network and execute the agreed touch point management system for faster customer connectivity and loan processing\-disbursement; escalate issues appropriately for timely resolution
* Attend industry events and conferences to promote our solutions and develop new business relationships


 Customer Servicing \& Relationship Management
   

  

* Coordinate with risk, operations, products \& customer success teams to execute robust, customer friendly loan approval and booking processes
* Recommend improvements to operating procedures and technological tools to enhance customer experience through reduced processing TATs while simultaneously ensuring compliant operations
* Ensure customer queries/ complaints are addressed in a timely and effective manner and coordinate personally to expedite the same
* Leverage close direct customer relationships to carry out post sanction surveillance and generate early warning signals on NPAs


 Risk Management
   

  

* Execute compliant sales operations and work in line with risk management principles via coordination with Risk team
* Ensure closure of deal documentation and credit administration requirements
* Support risk management by maintaining focus on prescribed guidelines and process checks at all stages of the unsecured loan transaction and raising potential alarm cases in advance
* Proactively identify and report risks in order to ensure portfolio quality is maintained
* Liaise with the channel partners, customers and the risk team on specific escalation cases


 Internal Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Proactively build and maintain relationships with key internal stakeholders (Risk, Operations, Product, Tech, Customer Success) for smooth and efficient transactions and issue resolution
* Drive faster TATs through effective loan sanctioning by building strong relationships with internal stakeholders in order to expand customer and channel base
* Partner with peer KAMs/RMs to overcome challenges and support sales growth

title: Financial Inclusion District Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vedavaag Systems Ltd is a technology\-driven company headquartered in India, focusing on innovative solutions that support governance, financial services, and inclusive growth. The organization works closely with public and private sector partners to extend essential services to underserved and rural communities. Vedavaag Systems Ltd emphasizes operational efficiency, customer\-centric service delivery, and sustainable models that promote financial inclusion. The company offers opportunities for professionals interested in social impact, technology\-enabled service delivery, and expanding access to financial services across diverse regions in India.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Financial Inclusion District Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Telangana, India. This role oversees district\-level financial inclusion initiatives, including planning, implementing, and monitoring programs that extend banking and financial services to underserved communities. The person in this role will manage field teams, coordinate with partner banks and agencies, track performance against outreach and service targets, and ensure compliance with relevant policies and guidelines. Daily responsibilities include reviewing operational reports, resolving escalated issues, conducting site visits, facilitating community engagement activities, and ensuring quality customer service and data accuracy. The District Manager will also promote inclusive practices, support training and capacity building for staff, and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and service delivery.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong Program Management and Project Management skills to plan, execute, and monitor district\-level financial inclusion initiatives.
* Experience in Diversity \& Inclusion and Employee Engagement to foster an inclusive, motivated, and high\-performing field workforce.
* Excellent Communication skills, including the ability to collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and community stakeholders.
* Background in banking, financial services, or financial inclusion programs is highly beneficial.
* Ability to analyze data, prepare performance reports, and use insights to drive improvements in outreach and service quality.
* Proven people\-management experience, including supervising field teams and conducting training and performance evaluations.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, social sciences, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Comfort working on\-site across district locations in Telangana and willingness to travel within the assigned region as needed.
